<header class="ws-head"><span class="ws-kicker">DPI-H for Health workshop · Convergence Bangkok 2026</span><h2>Two tracks, seven modules each, one journey</h2><p class="ws-carries">Each policy module asks one question of the journey and fills one sheet of the Country Canvas. <h3 id="technical-track">Technical track <span class="ws-badge">Draft</span></h3><p>Two days, one cross-border immunization story. Day 1 covers the building blocks and gets everyone running on Heropa. Day 2 is teams building one part of the journey, then seeing it all work together. Draft for the team to confirm. Names and times are proposals.</p>
<p class="ws-day">Day 1 · 30 November · <span class="ws-daysum">Concepts and the OHS stack. By the end of the day you have captured data, synced it, run a workflow and started a dashboard, all on Heropa.</span></p><div class="ws-cards">
<a class="ws-card ws-mod" href="workshop-t1.html"><span class="ws-mod-h"><span class="ws-id">T1</span><span class="ws-sheet">11:00–11:40</span></span><b>Building with FHIR and the Open Health Stack</b><span>Which FHIR resources, terminologies and tools carry this journey, and where does each lab use them?</span><span class="ws-steps"><span>J1</span><span>J3b</span><span>J4.0b</span></span></a>
<a class="ws-card ws-mod" href="workshop-t2.html"><span class="ws-mod-h"><span class="ws-id">T2</span><span class="ws-sheet">11:40–12:30</span></span><b>Offline data capture</b><span>How does a form on a health worker's phone become a patient record, with no signal?</span><span class="ws-steps"><span>J2a</span><span>J2b</span></span></a>
<a class="ws-card ws-mod" href="workshop-t3.html"><span class="ws-mod-h"><span class="ws-id">T3</span><span class="ws-sheet">13:30–13:50</span></span><b>Trust between countries: SMART Trust and the GDHCN</b><span>How can a clinic in one country trust a vaccination record from another, and when is a card better than a link?</span><span class="ws-steps"><span>J1</span><span>J3a</span><span>J4.1</span></span></a>
<a class="ws-card ws-mod" href="workshop-t4.html"><span class="ws-mod-h"><span class="ws-id">T4</span><span class="ws-sheet">13:50–15:00</span></span><b>Workflows, sync and who sees what</b><span>What should happen next for this child, how does the record reach the server, and who is allowed to see it?</span><span class="ws-steps"><span>J2b</span><span>J3b</span><span>J4.0b</span><span>J4.1</span></span></a>
<a class="ws-card ws-mod" href="workshop-t5.html"><span class="ws-mod-h"><span class="ws-id">T5</span><span class="ws-sheet">15:30–16:30</span></span><b>From records to charts</b><span>How does a FHIR record become a row, a chart and a coverage number, and who accessed what?</span><span class="ws-steps"><span>J2b</span><span>J3b</span><span>J4.1</span></span></a>
</div>
<p class="ws-day">Day 2 · 1 December · <span class="ws-daysum">Teams build one app in the journey, show it, and then everything runs together.</span></p><div class="ws-cards">
<a class="ws-card ws-mod" href="workshop-t6.html"><span class="ws-mod-h"><span class="ws-id">T6</span><span class="ws-sheet">11:00–11:30</span></span><b>Verifying a card, sharing a link</b><span>How does an app go from a scanned QR to a verified result, and from a shared link to the records behind it?</span><span class="ws-steps"><span>J3a</span><span>J4.0b</span><span>J4.1</span></span></a>
<a class="ws-card ws-mod" href="workshop-t7.html"><span class="ws-mod-h"><span class="ws-id">T7</span><span class="ws-sheet">11:30–16:15</span></span><b>Team build, showcase and the journey together</b><span>Can each team change one app in the journey and then run the whole journey live, from a birth abroad to a clinic back home to the family travelling again?</span><span class="ws-steps"><span>J2b</span><span>J3a</span><span>J4.0a</span><span>J4.1</span></span></a>
</div>

Day 2 apps need an emulator or the Wasm web build, since nobody installs Android Studio.</li><li>Lab 3: confirm Observable Framework, the shared test data, and Matt's help once the apps are seeded.</li><li>Which facilitator takes which Day 2 team.</li><li>A short recording of the full journey as a fallback for the finale.</li></ul>
